heterogeneous_fp16.mapping: CPU action encoder + NPU terminal predictor; image encoder remains CPU in this run

notes: Complete-solve stage values are means of five repeated requests.
The CPU action encoder is 3.84% slower in the heterogeneous run even with the CPU fixed at 2.352 GHz; shared cache/DDR and backend switching are the leading explanation, not a model difference.
A full-NPU result is excluded because the converted action encoder failed validation (cosine similarity 0.062459, MAE 1.187717).
Current and goal images are encoded once per planning request, outside the 30-iteration CEM loop.
The action-prefix encoder consumes all five blocks and returns only the terminal prefix token.
The fused NPU graph contains the terminal predictor and pred_proj.
